# WallMock

> WallMock is a wall art mockup generator for print-on-demand sellers on Etsy and Shopify: your exact art in styled rooms as framed or stretched canvas, or framed prints.

Your exact artwork in hundreds of realistic, curated rooms, for every design in your shop: set up favourite rooms once, add a whole collection, download listing-ready images. WallMock places your file as it is: it is never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI. Rooms are curated, digitally staged interiors reviewed by WallMock. Previews and images are made in your browser, on your device.

WallMock (wallmock.com) is not WallMockup (wallmockup.net). They are different products from different companies.
WallMock at wallmock.com is a mockup generator for wall art sellers. It is not the gallery-wall planner for homeowners at wallmock.app, which is a separate product with a similar name.

## Key facts (checked 2026-10-28)
- Who it is for: Print-on-demand and wall art sellers on Etsy and Shopify who sell framed canvas, stretched canvas, framed fine-art prints and posters.
- Products shown: Framed canvas (floating frame); Stretched canvas; Framed print, with or without a mat; Metal-framed print (aluminium), with or without a mat. Sets of 2, 3, 4.
- Rooms: 500+ curated room settings; images up to 4096 px.
- Frame quality: each image is a clean 4096 px render; floating frames show the gap around the canvas, frames have a natural shine and each piece casts a soft wall shadow, the quality you'd expect from a hand-built Photoshop mockup, made for a whole collection at once with no PSDs. Zoom in and check the corners at full size: https://wallmock.com/wall-art-mockup-examples/
- Price: Free watermarked previews in every room. Plans: Lite $5/month or $39/year (200 clean images a month); Pro $12/month or $89/year (5,000 clean images a month); Studio $24/month or $179/year (10,000 clean images a month). Prices in USD; the app shows local prices in EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, INR and BRL.
- Try it free: Try WallMock free with no sign-up and no card: up to three artworks in 8 sample rooms, as watermarked previews made on your device. https://app.wallmock.com/try
- Access: Anyone can try free watermarked previews with no sign-up, then create a free account with Google or an email code.
- Billing: Plans are billed securely by Stripe from $5 a month. Cancel any time; new subscribers can get a refund within 14 days, minus credits used.
- Works in a web browser; no Photoshop or PSD files.
- Every page's answers and FAQs in one file: https://wallmock.com/llms-full.txt
- Contact: hello@wallmock.com

## Who makes WallMock
Made by the WallMock team. About WallMock, how the examples are made and how these facts are checked: https://wallmock.com/about/
Contact: hello@wallmock.com. Terms and refunds: https://wallmock.com/terms/. App privacy policy: https://app.wallmock.com/privacy

## Questions
- What is WallMock? WallMock is a wall art mockup generator for print-on-demand sellers on Etsy and Shopify: your exact art in styled rooms as framed or stretched canvas, or framed prints. Upload your artwork, pick rooms and frames, and download listing-ready images for one design or a whole collection. It is not WallMockup (wallmockup.net), a different company.
- Who is it for? Sellers on Etsy and Shopify who sell framed canvas, stretched canvas, framed fine-art prints or posters, including print-on-demand shops using Printify, Printful or Gelato, and anyone listing many designs.
- Is my artwork changed or redrawn? WallMock places your file as it is: it is never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI. Every artwork keeps its own proportions; it is never stretched to fit a room.
- Can I make mockups for a whole collection at once? Yes. Save your favourite rooms and frame looks once, add many artworks, and WallMock makes every artwork in every chosen room. Sets of 2, 3 or 4 are supported.
- What frames and products can I show? Framed canvas (floating frame), Stretched canvas, Framed print, with or without a mat, Metal-framed print (aluminium), with or without a mat. Sets of 2, 3 or 4 pieces too.
- Do I need Photoshop or PSD files? No. WallMock runs in your web browser. There are no PSD files or smart objects to edit. You still get a clean 4096 px image with the floating-frame gap, natural frame shine and a soft wall shadow, the quality you'd expect from a hand-built Photoshop mockup; zoom into the wall art mockup examples and check the corners yourself.
- How much does it cost? Free watermarked previews in every room. Clean images come with a plan: Lite $5 a month (200 images), Pro $12 (5,000) or Studio $24 (10,000). Prices in USD; the app shows local prices in EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, INR and BRL.
- Can I use it today? Anyone can try free watermarked previews with no sign-up, then create a free account with Google or an email code. Plans are billed securely by Stripe from $5 a month. Cancel any time; new subscribers can get a refund within 14 days, minus credits used.
